name: Postcode Checkout – Postcode Validation
author: CodeBrain BV

sections.description:
Using WooCommerce for WordPress and want to make sure your customers enter valid, deliverable addresses? This plugin does the job perfectly!
Save time, reduce failed deliveries, and make checkout smoother by validating addresses in real time through trusted postcode databases.

Features

  • ✅ Easy to use – Quick setup and seamless integration with your WooCommerce checkout.
  • ✅ Accurate address validation – Verify customer data instantly using reliable postcode sources such as Postcode EU, PostcodeAPI, and Pro6PP.
  • ✅ Dutch & international support – Works with national (The Netherlands) and international addresses across: The Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, Luxembourg, Austria, Switzerland, France, United Kingdom, Spain, Denmark, Norway, Finland, and Sweden.
  • ✅ Fully configurable – Adjust validation rules and settings to match your webshop’s workflow.
  • ✅ 30-day free demo – Try it risk-free and see how much time you save!

Requirements

⚙️ This plugin requires an active Postcode Checkout account and plan to perform address validation.
This plugin requires an active Postcode Checkout account and plan to perform address validation.
You can create a free demo plan and test the plugin for 30 days before choosing your subscription.
This plugin requires an active postcode database account (i.e. Postcode EU, PostcodeAPI, Pro6PP)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
    or the zip with the installer through the ‘Add New’ button in the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

  2. Activate it through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

Why use this plugin?

  • ✔ Improve delivery accuracy
  • ✔ Reduce customer input errors
  • ✔ Enhance checkout experience
sections.faq:
Where do I acquire a license?

A year long license can be purchased from https://www.postcode-checkout.nl/nl/integraties/woocommerce. This license is REQUIRED.
A demo license can also be acquired here for free to be able to test for 30 days.

What is a postcode database provider?

A postcode database provider is a company that manages all addresses within a certain country. Our plug-in uses this data to enrichen the plug-in after a validation.

Which postcode database providers do you support?

We currently support the following providers.

  • PostcodeNL
  • PostcodeAPI
  • Pro6PP
